units.title: SG-4.2.2 Untrack node_modules files in game/frontend with tested cleanup code
Act: Add untrackNodeModules cleanup and CLI script

tests.name: keeps only paths with a node_modules segment and ignores look-alike names
tests.title: trackedNodeModulesPaths keeps only paths with a node_modules segment and ignores look-alike names
tests.scenario: Given ['node_modules/phaser/a.js','src/a.ts','src/my_node_modules_note.ts'], when filtered, then the result equals ['node_modules/phaser/a.js']
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/trackedNodeModules.test.ts -t trackedNodeModulesPaths --testTimeout=20000

tests.id: trackedNodeModulesPaths returns empty for empty input
tests.name: returns an empty list when given no paths
tests.title: trackedNodeModulesPaths returns an empty list when given no paths
tests.scenario: Given [], when filtered, then the result equals []
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/trackedNodeModules.test.ts -t trackedNodeModulesPaths --testTimeout=20000

units.title: Verify: untrackNodeModules cleanup unit tests with a fake git runner

tests.name: untrackNodeModules > removes node_modules from the git index recursively using a cached-only rm
tests.title: removes node_modules from the git index recursively using a cached-only rm
tests.scenario: Given a fake git runner that returns empty output, when untrackNodeModules is called with it, then one call removes the node_modules directory with rm -r --cached.

tests.name: untrackNodeModules > only ever uses the --cached flag so working-tree files are never deleted
tests.title: only ever uses the --cached flag so working-tree files are never deleted
tests.scenario: Given a fake git runner that returns empty output, when untrackNodeModules is called with it, then every git call carries --cached.

tests.name: untrackNodeModules > also untracks the vitest results cache file under node_modules
tests.title: also untracks the vitest results cache file under node_modules
tests.scenario: Given a fake git runner that returns empty output, when untrackNodeModules is called with it, then one call untracks node_modules/.vite/vitest/results.json.

units.title: Verify: guard fails while any dependency path is tracked

tests.name: assertNoTrackedNodeModules throws and names the tracked node_modules path when one is present
tests.title: throws and names the tracked node_modules path when one is present
tests.scenario: Given a tracked file list containing node_modules/phaser/x.js, when the guard asserts no tracked node_modules paths, then it throws an error naming that path

tests.name: assertNoTrackedNodeModules does not throw when no tracked path is under node_modules
tests.title: does not throw when no tracked path is under node_modules
tests.scenario: Given a tracked file list with only src/a.ts, when the guard asserts no tracked node_modules paths, then it completes without throwing
